title: MFA Sign-up Flow
diagram:
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant Frontend
    participant Backend
    participant IBM Verify

    User->>Frontend: Enter registration details
    Frontend->>Backend: POST /api/auth/signup/mfa
    Backend->>IBM Verify: POST /oauth2/token
    IBM Verify-->>Backend: Admin token
    Backend->>IBM Verify: POST /v2.0/Users
    IBM Verify-->>Backend: User created
    Backend->>IBM Verify: POST /v2.0/factors/totp
    Note over Backend,IBM Verify: Generate TOTP QR code
    IBM Verify-->>Backend: TOTP details & QR code
    Backend-->>Frontend: QR code & TOTP details
    Frontend->>User: Display QR code
    User->>User: Scan QR with authenticator
    User->>Frontend: Enter TOTP code
    Frontend->>Backend: POST /api/auth/signup/mfa
    Note over Frontend,Backend: Include userId, totpId, totpCode
    Backend->>IBM Verify: POST /v2.0/factors/totp/{totpId}
    IBM Verify-->>Backend: Verification result
    Backend-->>Frontend: Success response
    Frontend->>Frontend: Redirect to sign-in
